newsitem.title: THAILAND: Int'l Finance to issue 130.28 mln shares.
newsitem.headline: Int'l Finance to issue 130.28 mln shares.

text.p: International Trust and Finance Plc said on Monday it will issue 130.28 million new shares through a rights issue to raise its registered capital to 2.52 billion baht from 1.22 billion baht.
The new shares will be offered to existing shareholders at a ratio of 1.07 new shares at 10 baht each to one old share, International Trust said in a filing to the Stock Exchange of Thailand.
International Trust is one of 10 finance companies ordered by the Bank of Thailand early this month to increase their capital.
The company said the proceeds would be used to expand business and restore investor and public confidence.
